app.title: Harness Engineering 101: The LLM is the brain, the harness is the body
app.author: isuruwijesiri
app.description: A modular framework for building LLM harnesses that combine reasoning, memory, and action modules.
proposed_tests: pip install harness-engineering-101 and import harness module
Instantiate a simple harness with a dummy LLM and run a basic prompt to ensure output generation
Verify that the memory component stores and retrieves data by injecting a known token and checking retrieval
Measure end-to-end latency for a short prompt and compare against a baseline using LangChain
Run unit tests included in the repository to confirm all modules are functional
